settings.title:
No secrets.
Science, simplified.
settings.text: Every active, every functional ingredient, and exactly why it's there. Clinical concentrations, total transparency — no marketing names, no hidden complexes.

settings.name: Alpha-Arbutin
settings.desc: Blocks melanin production at the source — not by stripping pigment, but by stopping new dark spots from forming. Clinically validated for PIH on South Asian skin tones.
settings.why_text: EU-validated as the exact efficacy threshold without irritation. Not rounded up, not cut down.

settings.name: Triple Ceramide Complex
settings.inci: CERAMIDE NP · CERAMIDE AP · CERAMIDE EOP
settings.desc: Your skin barrier is 50% ceramides. One ceramide type leaves gaps. All three, plus cholesterol and phytosphingosine, rebuild it properly.
settings.why_text: Your skin contains NP, AP, and EOP in specific proportions. One type alone is like patching a wall with one kind of brick.

settings.name: 6-Filter UV System
settings.inci: TINOSORB M · MEXORYL SX · OCTISALATE · ENSULIZOLE
settings.desc: No single UV filter covers 280nm–400nm. Six filters working together leave zero gaps — zero white cast, matte finish.
settings.why_text: Pakistan's UV index hits 10–12 in summer. Most SPFs here were tested at the European standard of 4. That's not the same protection.

settings.label: Hero Ingredients
settings.title:
Three ingredients.
Everything built around them.
settings.text: Each product is built around one star active — chosen for clinical evidence, not trends.

settings.name: Niacinamide
settings.short_fn: Minimises pores, evens skin tone, and strengthens the barrier.
settings.desc: Niacinamide is a powerhouse vitamin that manages oil, calms redness, and improves uneven skin tone.
settings.why: It is one of the most researched and stable ingredients in modern skincare.

settings.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
settings.short_fn: Penetrates deeper than standard HA to hydrate from within.
settings.desc: A smaller molecule weight of Hyaluronic Acid that can penetrate the top layer of skin.
settings.why: Topical hydration is temporary; internal hydration lasts.

settings.name: Panthenol (B5)
settings.short_fn: Locks moisture in and accelerates skin healing.
settings.desc: A soothing humectant that also helps the skin produce more lipids to repair the barrier.
settings.why: Essential for reducing trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL).
